analysis:
This batch contains only changelog fragments and one architecture doc edit (hardware-support.md), with no executable source. Findings need a visible line, and the described behavior cannot be checked against code, so I report none. Open questions follow.

1. Weight-hash caching (af534773f14ec697, changelog.d/glm-startup-single-verification.md lines 3-4). Coordinator-mode start would register GLM's last verified hash from an owner-only `~/.darkbloom/verified-weights.json`. The record is keyed on device, inode, size, mtime and ctime. This touches A-004, T-012, T-027 and the T-034 weight-hash binding. The operator (ADV-001) owns that file and could forge the record or restore file metadata. The mitigation is the managed load's own full SHA-256 check against the catalog manifest before serving, with a fail on identity change. That ordering, and whether the published hash can diverge from the verified one, cannot be checked without the code. Please check the TOCTOU window between registration and load, and the record's integrity binding.

2. Page cache counted as available memory (a2215750c4559ac5; hardware-support.md lines 256-262). Admission can now over-admit if the page-cache or purgeable counters are inaccurate. The change only raises the figure and is never stricter. Post-load KVHeadroomProbe checks and the unified cap remain as backstops, so I see an availability risk at most, not a confidentiality one. The docs say weight hashing and the managed GLM load drop cached weight pages after reading. That is a plaintext-weights-in-cache point, not a prompt-data exposure.

3. GLM structured output, forced tool choice and logprobs (83ad8beddc1c4ac2, 3c5cf8a139dad108, dfaad60fdf00ab5c). These widen the accepted request surface (T-008/T-010 area). Output is withheld until it validates against the schema, and failures return 422 with no content. Typed 400 refusals before reservation reduce the false-sickness DoS. I could not verify the encryption and validation paths. Strict-schema validation is a provider-side check and so is not proof against ADV-001 (T-007).

4. Variable-frame-rate video and wired-limit guidance are advice or decoding changes only. The sysctl text is printed, not executed.
